scripts.dev: pnpm exec concurrently --kill-others --kill-signal SIGKILL -n web,server -c blue,green "pnpm --filter mini-app dev:web" "pnpm --filter server dev"
scripts.validate: pnpm exec concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --kill-signal SIGKILL -n lint,tsc -c red,blue "pnpm --filter mini-app lint:build" "pnpm --filter mini-app tsc"
scripts.kill:all: pkill -9 -f 'concurrently' 2>/dev/null || true; pkill -9 -f 'nest start' 2>/dev/null || true; pkill -9 -f 'taro build' 2>/dev/null || true; pkill -9 -f 'node.*dev' 2>/dev/null || true; echo 'All dev processes cleaned'
